about: Explainer cards for C9, editorial. Each: title, body (one or two sentences), optional kicker. ?n= picks one; otherwise the page cycles every 12 s.

cards.title: What counts as an independent
cards.body: Any candidate on the ballot who is not the Democratic or Republican nominee: no party, a minor party, or a nonpartisan line.

cards.title: Who they caucus with
cards.body: An independent senator chooses which party to meet with for committee seats. King and Sanders sit with the Democrats; a new independent decides for themselves.

cards.title: Ranked choice in Alaska
cards.body: Voters rank the candidates. If nobody has a majority of first choices, the last-placed candidate is dropped and their ballots move to the next choice, until someone passes 50%.
